description: This file is a script for managing build, watch, and process control in the Notesnook desktop application, including file watching, process spawning, and cleanup routines.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when files change, including rebuilding, rebuilding dependencies, and restarting processes.

methods.name: spawnAndWaitUntil
methods.description: Spawns a process and resolves when a predicate condition on output data is met.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a shell command synchronously with environment variables.

methods.name: execAsync
methods.description: Spawns a process asynchronously, with optional restartability and callback on exit.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: killProcesses
methods.description: Kills a list of processes using tree-kill.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup by killing processes and removing build directory.

methods.name: isBundleSame
methods.description: Checks if the current build bundle matches the previous by hashing build files.
